newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 10,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 10,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) said on Monday it was offering 10,000 tonnes of lentils for sale, an official spokesman said.
He told Reuters that an international request for prices had been issued and October 15 was set as final date to receive price offers.
He said the quantity from the 1995 crops includes 5,000 tonnes whole red lentils and 5,000 tonnes split red lentils.
